items.headline: Terence Tao's ICM essay asks what mathematics values once AI can do research
items.summary: Tao posted "Mathematics in the age of AI", based on his public lecture at the 2026 International Congress of Mathematicians. It assumes AI will reach research-level capability and asks how the community should respond, using problem-solving as a case study for the goals and values of mathematical research.
